choices.label: Back delivered capacity
choices.mechanism: The operator directly reports a concrete service-readiness milestone.
choices.risk: Remaining phases, customer acceptance and economics are still separate gates.

choices.label: Back tenant utilization
choices.mechanism: CoreWeave can use delivered capacity to expand AI cloud service.
choices.risk: The release does not establish utilization, tenant revenue or acceptance timing.

choices.label: Back supporting infrastructure
choices.mechanism: Ready data halls embody power and cooling equipment demand.
choices.risk: No vendor attribution or content value is disclosed.

briefing.headline: IREN announces a five-year, approximately $9.7 billion Microsoft agreement for a planned 200 MW deployment.
briefing.simpleMeaning: A giant contract headline still depends on staged physical delivery.
briefing.directFact: IREN announces customer, term, stated contract value and planned deployment scale.
briefing.physicalMeaning: The operator must deliver sites, power, GB300 systems, networking and operations to contractual gates.
briefing.criticalUnknown: Contract value is not upfront revenue; delivery schedule, costs, acceptance and billing determine realization.

choices.label: Back the operator
choices.mechanism: IREN is the direct provider with the announced contract and delivery obligation.
choices.risk: Financing, concentration and delivery execution are substantial.

choices.label: Back the customer
choices.mechanism: Microsoft secures external AI infrastructure for cloud demand.
choices.risk: The contract can increase capital and service costs before associated benefits.

choices.label: Back the GB300 platform
choices.mechanism: The planned deployment explicitly depends on next-generation NVIDIA systems.
choices.risk: Stated deployment plans are not completed shipments or recognized NVIDIA revenue.

briefing.headline: Nebius announces a Meta agreement with dedicated and additional conditional capacity components.
briefing.simpleMeaning: The contract architecture separates committed demand from capacity that still depends on conditions.
briefing.directFact: Nebius describes the named customer and distinguishes dedicated from conditional components.
briefing.physicalMeaning: Different capacity tranches can carry different construction, delivery and revenue certainty.
briefing.criticalUnknown: Conditional capacity should not be counted as delivered or guaranteed revenue.

choices.label: Back contracted growth
choices.mechanism: Nebius directly adds a named large customer agreement.
choices.risk: Conditional capacity, execution and customer concentration affect realized value.

choices.label: Back customer demand
choices.mechanism: Meta is the named buyer expanding access to AI infrastructure.
choices.risk: Infrastructure commitments increase cost and do not alone prove product monetization.

choices.label: Back platform supply
choices.mechanism: Future AI capacity is tied to advanced accelerator availability.
choices.risk: The announcement does not establish exact NVIDIA unit timing or economics.

briefing.headline: TeraWulf announces a 401 MW, 20-year Anthropic lease with phased future delivery.
briefing.simpleMeaning: A very long contract concentrates enormous value in execution that has not happened yet.
briefing.directFact: TeraWulf announces the customer, planned capacity, term and delivery structure.
briefing.physicalMeaning: The project needs power, site buildout, cooling, compute installation and customer acceptance across phases.
briefing.criticalUnknown: A signed future lease is not delivered capacity, billing or recognized revenue.

choices.label: Back the operator
choices.mechanism: TeraWulf is the direct operator and lease counterparty.
choices.risk: The scale, long duration, financing and phased build create concentrated execution risk.

choices.label: Back power and cooling buildout
choices.mechanism: Hundreds of planned megawatts require extensive facility and electrical equipment.
choices.risk: No supplier award, timing or content is disclosed.

choices.label: Back the compute platform
choices.mechanism: Anthropic's infrastructure demand ultimately requires accelerator systems.
choices.risk: The lease source does not specify accelerator procurement or delivery timing.

briefing.headline: IREN says Horizon 1, 50 MW, was delivered to and accepted by Microsoft.
briefing.simpleMeaning: A planned contract reaches customer acceptance, while billing remains an unproven next gate.
briefing.directFact: IREN reports delivery and customer acceptance of the 50 MW Horizon 1 facility.
briefing.physicalMeaning: The site has crossed a stronger delivery gate than plan, lease or ready-for-service alone.
briefing.criticalUnknown: The announcement does not say billing commenced or establish recognized revenue and margin.

choices.label: Back proven delivery
choices.mechanism: IREN directly reports delivery and customer acceptance of a defined facility.
choices.risk: Acceptance does not itself prove billing, utilization, margin or later-phase execution.

choices.label: Back the customer and cloud
choices.mechanism: Microsoft has accepted additional AI infrastructure capacity.
choices.risk: The 50 MW facility may be immaterial to Microsoft and economics are undisclosed.

choices.label: Back the GB300 platform
choices.mechanism: The delivered infrastructure supports an NVIDIA GB300 deployment.
choices.risk: Site acceptance does not disclose GPU revenue recognition or full utilization.
